source.description: Three-part repair plan: structural classification, shared Mill cost payment, and nonmutating payment-window rejection. Full work product retained separately by its recorded hash.

Changes requested: preserve triggers across paused payment, use the captured activator on resumption, complete structural movement decisions, and add production-path coverage. Full work product retained separately by its recorded hash.

The earlier planning summaries associate work with the current repeated baseline on the same frozen cases. Those receipt IDs are retrospective cross-references, not a claim that the exact later receipt was supplied to the original agent. Initial planning used retained development diagnostics; subsequent reviews used the same baseline source and frozen experiment boundaries. Original prompts and full reports are retained privately.
Revised the plan to preserve triggers, capture the activator across continuations, and enumerate structural library movement. An independent review subsequently found additional gaps.

Changes requested: preserve the identity of a single Mill obligation across replacement pauses, model retained selections after zero-card Dig, and distinguish partial mana-trigger processing from whole-event consumption.
Proposed a retained Mill event group and corrected zero-card Dig and partial trigger ownership. Broad library-origin analysis remained subject to independent review.
Changes requested: precise RevealHand/Search/RevealTop binding transfers, and discovery of ordinary cost triggers before a later cost removes their observers.

Bound the first repair to reusable immediate drawing and milling families found by this source-qualified experiment, with complete Mill payment, trigger and continuation semantics. Full library-origin analysis is a separate unclaimed project. Retain its RevealHand/Search/RevealTop findings without claiming them fixed. The ordinary-cost observer lifetime finding remains in this repair. No frozen source case, evaluator, gate, or expectation changed.

Bounded the proposed repair to immediate explicit Draw/Mill families while retaining complete payment, observer lifetime, and replacement-group requirements. Broader library-origin analysis remains unclaimed.

Requested revisions for nested complete-cost selections, deferred ordinary triggers during manual mana funding, and persistent delayed-trigger multiplicity. Static review; no engine implementation or passing runtime claim.

Specified complete cost selections, payment-aware trigger disposition and persistent delayed occurrence collection in the combined Draw/Mill plan. The plan remains subject to independent review; no engine changes or passing runtime results are claimed.
Independent combined plan review found four material payment/observer boundary gaps. No code was changed.

Plan the first partial engine candidate: six explicit Draw definitions use the stack; two Mill-cost cases and all eighteen frozen gates remain unchanged. Expected experiment rejection; no implementation yet.

Measure the six Draw repairs as an intermediate candidate while preserving the two Mill failures and all eighteen frozen acceptance gates. A rejected partial result will be followed by a separate combined attempt under the same frozen experiment.

Independent review found no blocking gaps in the bounded six-card Draw plan. It verified source text, immediate versus future instruction boundaries, ordinary stack/color continuation and nonmutating mana-window rejection. Runtime tests remain required; both Mill failures and all eighteen gates stay unchanged.

Plan the remaining real Tap-and-Mill family: ordinary payment currently skips Mill while the mana payer admits an empty library. The proposed repair binds affordability, announcement payment, replacement continuation and deferred observers to typed supported costs; richer unsupported costs and replacement programs must fail before mutation. No implementation or acceptance is claimed.

The independent review requested revision of the bounded Tap and Mill plan. Seven concrete gaps concerned optional replacement decline, checked replacement counts, cost-origin persistence across choices, delayed-trigger context, adjusted activation costs, replacement-definition closure, and batching observers produced by state-based actions. No engine patch or passing result was produced by this review.

The revised plan specifies a bounded native Tap and Mill cost path, fixed-count replacement support, persisted payment origin, captured delayed-observer context, adjusted-cost preflight, and observer settlement after state-based actions. Complex unsupported costs and replacement states must be refused before mutation. This is planning evidence only; no Mill implementation or measured repair exists yet.

Implemented the bounded native Draw exclusion, direct mana guards and payment preflight in four files. Thirteen focused tests, formatting, CR checks and full Clippy passed. The full engine library test run had16593passing,1failing and7ignored tests: Manamorphose serialized IR still expected the old computed mana-ability flag. Executor stopped for the required fifth-file snapshot scope correction; export and the rest of the full suite remain unrun. No independent implementation review or factory acceptance is claimed.

Traced the failed Manamorphose test through both serialized snapshots. The first failing assertion hid a second stored view with the same obsolete derived mana flag. The plan specifies both exact metadata removals and preserves all semantic fields and assertions. Its five-file scope stop came from an overly narrow parent instruction, not from the user; the parent authorizes review of both specifically documented snapshot fixtures. No runtime repair or green suite is claimed.

Independent source review found three remaining runtime gaps: library self-replacements were admitted but unavailable to existing replacement lookup; deferred trigger collection lost distinct state-based-action groups or split a paused simultaneous group; and the authenticated decision-maker was confused with the player paying activation costs under turn control. The next plan may narrow unsupported profiles instead of extending unrelated engine machinery. No Mill patch or test result exists yet.

The complete Draw plan is clean under the parent-resolved scope including the two specifically documented Manamorphose snapshots. Independent source inspection verified both exact computed-flag removals, preserved semantic fields and existing assertions, genuine mana controls, and the required production verification map. This is plan review only; implementation and full verification remain pending.

Full bounded Mill plan03 refuses unsupported self-replacement and payment-relevant P/T profiles before mutation; carries the semantic Priority payer through payment and continuation, with explicit supported replacement and observer tests. No implementation or candidate observation.

Independent full review of Mill plan03 found three concrete gaps in admitted behavior: combined APNAP sorting, semantic priority return across observer settlement, and the source-stability guard during nonterminal multiplayer concession. No implementation or candidate results; narrow two-player closure recommended.

Full Mill plan04 adds stable combined APNAP ordering, preserves the semantic activator through observer settlement and saved ordering, and confines the source-stability certificate to ordinary two-player games with terminal concessions. Existing unsupported-profile refusals retained; no implementation or candidate observation.
Full card export uses the unoptimized dev profile and emits no per-card progress. A read-only audit found an active worker; it did not establish completion or an ETA.

Completed the reviewed two Manamorphose metadata snapshot corrections with unchanged Rust, both live assertions and genuine-mana controls. All19796engine tests and35802face unfiltered export/current native validation passed. Preserved and explained a private Birds keyword-input comparison failure. Independent implementation review and frozen candidate measurements pending; Mill remains outside this patch.

payload.description: Exclude potentially positive immediate Draw instructions from the shared native mana classifier, guard direct mana execution and manual-payment entry, and use ordinary activation and stack resolution for the five Scryfall Eggs and Chromatic Sphere. This partial candidate leaves the two native Mill-cost cases unresolved; it is measured against the unchanged full experiment and is not presented as acceptance.

source.description: Fresh full-diff review found no material issue in the bounded Draw repair. Independently ran 11 production integration tests and two private count tests, verified 1710 source inputs and both binaries, audited full engine/export evidence and all fourteen rules annotations, and confirmed the two computed-only Manamorphose snapshot changes. This source review is separate from frozen experiment acceptance; the Mill cases remain unfixed.

source.description: Fresh full-plan review found two remaining gaps in the native Mill payment proposal: multiple applicable optional replacements can force an optional branch, and positive-Mill admission guards would also restrict genuine zero-count mana abilities. The review accepts a bounded pre-mutation refusal for unsupported replacement combinations and requires production route controls preserving zero-count mana payment. Prior APNAP ordering, captured-payer priority and two-player concession corrections were supported by source inspection. No implementation or experiment result is claimed.

Independent retained-build audit found no material comparability mismatch: all31 baseline harness paths,48 candidate harness paths and2054 Phase source paths matched the recorded identities. Compiler lines agree; terminal newline and four added builder receipt metadata fields are explicitly retained. This verifies retained bytes and comparisons, not independently reproduced compilation or experiment acceptance.

The real partial-candidate rejection exposed mobile overflow and opaque case hashes. Wrapping preserved the full reason while reducing page width from498 to390pixels. Typed plan, candidate execution and feedback links now name the remaining gate violations, bounded to this decision sequence so future candidates do not rewrite history.
source.provider: Factory viewer improvement from a recorded rejection

source.description: Fresh full replacement plan addresses the prior review findings by refusing potentially shared optional replacement choices before mutation and separating the ordinary positive-Mill payment certificate from genuine zero-count mana routes. It retains the full bounded payment, observer, priority, persistence and test specification, with supported neighboring cases for every refusal. This is a source-based proposal awaiting independent whole-plan review; no implementation or candidate result is claimed.

Fresh whole-plan review requires two corrections: distinguish retained completed-resolution snapshots from active continuations at admission, and supply an accessible concrete production test for nonzero-offset event occurrence ownership. Other reviewed dimensions had no further material findings, but the plan is not clean. No Mill implementation followed; the user requested a committed checkpoint and handoff.
Published reviewed Draw partial; frozen experiment remains rejected with two Mill violations. Recording closed at user-requested checkpoint; no Mill implementation or Coworld runtime pin update.
